description: UPDATE of one credit_balances row, measured inside a rolled-back transaction

context.label: baseline-repeat
context.description: Variance of the measurement harness: each case run 10 times, each repetition with 3 warmup and 20 measured runs (DDL: 3 runs).
context.data: synthetic 10M-row Ledgerline benchmark database (pnpm seed --yes, seed 20251001), full shadow copy
context.notes: Run on a developer laptop with other applications open: nothing else was started by this script, but the machine was not dedicated.
